title: Small coherent colimits generated by coproducts and pushouts
statement: Use quasicategories, mapping spaces, coherent functors and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Fix a universe $\mathcal U$ and let $\mathcal C$ be a quasicategory in a larger universe. Then $\mathcal C$ admits colimits of every $\mathcal U$-small simplicial diagram if and only if it admits all $\mathcal U$-small coproducts (including the empty coproduct) and all pushouts. If $\mathcal C$ has these colimits and $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ is any coherent functor to a quasicategory in a sufficiently large universe, then $F$ preserves all $\mathcal U$-small colimits if and only if it preserves all $\mathcal U$-small coproducts and all pushouts. In the preservation assertion, saying that $F$ preserves a colimit includes existence of the corresponding colimit of the image diagram in $\mathcal D$. Neither local $\mathcal U$-smallness nor presentability is assumed.

source.place: Duals of Theorem 7.3.22 and Proposition 7.3.23, printed p. 356 (PDF p. 371). No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical existence and preservation theorem. Read online on 2026-10-17; not archived in literature/.
